stem: Your work space is part of customer service.
why: Tangibles: quality in what can be seen or felt, including the physical facility. Cleanliness is also the first of the 7-11 decisions.
keyFact: Work space part of customer service: True (Tangibles: physical facility)

stem: AI and human customer service can co-exist.
why: The hybrid model: AI handles FAQs and routine tasks, humans focus on complex or emotional cases, with a seamless handoff between them.
keyFact: AI and human service co-exist: True (hybrid model)

stem: What are the five points that customers evaluate?

flashcard.front: What are the five points that customers evaluate?

keyFact: 5 points of service quality: Reliability, Assurance, Tangibles, Empathy, Responsiveness (memory aid: RATER)

stem: Customers evaluate service quality on five points. Which of these is NOT one of them?
why: The five points: Reliability, Assurance, Tangibles, Empathy, Responsiveness.

flashcard.front: How do customers evaluate quality service? What do they consider?
flashcard.back: Five points: Reliability, Assurance, Tangibles, Empathy, Responsiveness

What percentage of consumers will pay more for a better customer experience?
keyFact: Pay more for better experience: 86% of consumers

stem: According to McKinsey, what percentage of buying experiences are based on how the customer feels?
keyFact: Buying experiences based on how the customer feels: 70% (McKinsey)

stem: Of 100 airline customers who encounter delayed baggage, what share don't complain at all?
why: 90% don't complain; only 10% complain, spread across baggage agents, reservations, social media, and other channels.

stem: Which of these is NOT one of the 7-11 decisions customers make about you?
why: The 11: cleanliness, warmth, credible, knowledgeable, responsive, friendly, helpful, understanding, courteous, confident, professional.

stem: Which service-quality point covers trust and confidence in you, product knowledge, and listening skills?
keyFact: Assurance: trust and confidence, skills and knowledge, product knowledge, listening

options: Willingness to assist customers, prompt service, and resolving problems quickly
Trust and confidence in you and the knowledge to do the job well
Caring, individualized attention, available when customers need help
Performing and living up to promises; dependable and accurate
why: The other choices describe Assurance, Empathy, and Reliability.
keyFact: Responsiveness: willing to assist, prompt, resolve problems quickly

stem: Under the Tangibles point, customers consider the physical facility, equipment, staff, and letters.
keyFact: Tangibles: what can be seen or felt (facility, equipment, staff, letters)

stem: In the hybrid model of customer service, what does AI handle?
why: Humans focus on complex or emotional cases, with a seamless handoff between AI and human agents.

stem: Compared with human customer service, AI customer service is strong in complex cases.
why: AI struggles with nuance; human customer service is strong in complex cases.

stem: Who said, "Your most unhappy customers are your greatest source of learning"?
